description: This file defines constants, structures, and function prototypes related to handling 'mtimes' files associated with packed git objects within a version control system. It declares functions to load mtimes data and retrieve modification times for objects stored in a pack.

methods.name: load_pack_mtimes
methods.description: Loads the .mtimes file corresponding to a packed_git object, returning zero on success.

methods.name: nth_packed_mtime
methods.description: Returns the mtime associated with the object at a specific position in a pack.
